academies.blurb: The mathematical spine of engineering and science: sixteen modules from sets, logic, and proofs through linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, and numerical methods. Four executable Python labs (NumPy matrix ops, Monte Carlo estimation, gradient descent from scratch, numerical quadrature) make every major idea runnable. Standard, correct mathematics throughout — original instructional content, no invented theorems.
academies.name: Mathematics for Engineers & Scientists
academies.tagline: Discrete math to numerical methods — the math working engineers actually use.

academies.blurb: Philosophy, history, writing, rhetoric, economics, and law as working disciplines for builders: logic and fallacies, three ethical traditions plus applied technology ethics, epistemology and the replication crisis, history of science and technology, technical writing, persuasion, economics for engineers, and policy literacy. Discussion frameworks and ethical decision-tree scenarios throughout.
academies.name: Humanities for Technologists
academies.tagline: Philosophy, history, writing, economics — the disciplines of judgment.

academies.blurb: The deep occult library: sixteen modules on the Western mystery traditions and their counterparts — Kabbalah, Hermeticism, alchemy, astrology, tarot, Enochian magic, Rosicrucianism, Theosophy, the Golden Dawn, grimoires, Gnosticism, Eastern esoteric traditions, divination systems, sacred geometry, and the modern revival. Presented throughout as the traditions present themselves: scholarly and descriptive, never as verified science.
academies.name: The Deep Library — Esoteric & Secret Knowledge
academies.tagline: The mystery traditions, studied as traditions — scholarly, never credulous.

academies.blurb: Cutting-edge research distilled: ten seed modules on the durable core of fast-moving fields — transformers, quantum computing, CRISPR, fusion, brain–computer interfaces, AI agents, semiconductors, synthetic biology, space infrastructure — plus the frontier method for tracking the edge honestly. Every module as-of dated; a daily pipeline appends new modules as the frontier moves.
academies.name: The Frontier — Cutting-Edge Research Distilled
academies.tagline: Fast-moving fields, honestly dated — the durable core plus the method.
